summary: In North Cove, Washington coast, North Cove Dynamic Revetment is a monitoring and adaptive management initiative. The program uses site-specific dynamic revetment using cobble/rocks, with monitoring and adaptive management. The case addresses bounded coastal erosion/flooding exposure and shoreline adaptation action. Available materials report dynamic revetment installed, monitoring, adaptive-management activities reported. Site monitoring observations reported, and no universal effect estimate. The case is presented as an implementation example, not as evidence that the same results will occur in another place or under different conditions.
